environment.description: Quarkus 3.2 native image deployed on AWS Lambda custom runtime with Amazon Linux 2 base. Container runs with a custom AppArmor profile (lambda-quarkus-confined) loaded via the container image's /etc/apparmor.d/ at build time. The profile specifies: deny /var/log/app/** w, deny /tmp/** w, allow /var/task/** r, and critically includes a network-level restriction via 'deny network raw,' combined with a Quarkus Vert.x configuration (quarkus.http.header.X-Tracking-Source.max-length=64, quarkus.http.header.X-Callback-URL.max-length=256) that truncates oversized header values. The AppArmor profile also restricts file creation outside /var/task/ preventing log poisoning. Note: the AppArmor profile does NOT directly filter HTTP response headers - it restricts the filesystem and network syscall surface.

config.vertx_header_validation: enabled - rejects header values containing CR (0x0D) or LF (0x0A) characters, throwing IllegalArgumentException before response is written to socket
